criterio_pre_registrado.unidade: judgeable transect (list and offsets read from the judge output, not recomputed)

familia_secundaria.correcao: Holm within the secondary family (2 tests)

criterio_pre_registrado.produto_julgado: V23 and MLP = GLO-30 minus the MEAN of the 5 Delta seeds (SEEDS_PAR), as in juiz_lidar_v4.py; GLO-30/FABDEM/GEDTM30 = single realization; the por_semente block redoes the confirmatory test with each seed in isolation
criterio_pre_registrado.correcao: Holm within the confirmatory family (2 tests)
criterio_pre_registrado.metrica: NMAD per transect-band; difference = NMAD(a) - NMAD(b); negative = a is less dispersed
criterio_pre_registrado.poder: Power formula: MDE80 = (t_{1-alpha/2,n-1} + t_{0.80,n-1}) * dp/sqrt(n), with dp the standard deviation
criterio_pre_registrado.exploratorias: remaining bands and pairs: raw p, no verdict

por_semente_confirmatorio.nota: E1: V23 of each single seed against FABDEM (single realization), ETH stratum; the mean of 5 seeds reduces the NMAD of the product

frase_autorizada.20-30m: Across 12 independent lidar transects the paired difference in NMAD between the reconstruction and FABDEM in the 20-30m stratum is -0.24 m (95% CI [-0.61, +0.04]; Holm-adjusted p = 0.353), which does not establish an ordering; the design could detect a difference of about 0.49 m with 80% power.
frase_autorizada.>30m: Across 11 independent lidar transects the paired difference in NMAD between the reconstruction and FABDEM in the >30m stratum is +0.02 m (95% CI [-0.26, +0.34]; Holm-adjusted p = 0.700), which does not establish an ordering; the design could detect a difference of about 0.41 m with 80% power.
